mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_dingtalk_dept_map (id, tenant_id, dingtalk_dept_id, sys_dept_id, dept_name, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{dingtalkDeptId}, #{sysDeptId}, #{deptName}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sys_dept_id = VALUES(sys_dept_id), dept_name = VALUES(dept_name), update_time = NOW()
